59.94 → 30 fps (frames dropped, none interpolated)
video re-encoded once (x264 crf 18, 1 thread)
audio stream copied

sandy_demo.command: ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 4 -t 21 -i sandy_hackett_v2.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset medium -threads 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart sandy_hackett_v2_demo.mp4
edits: trim 4 s → 25 s (from the first steady moment; the walk-in at 0–4.5 s and the bobbing from 19 s on excluded)
25 fps unchanged
video re-encoded once (x264 crf 18, 1 thread)
audio stream copied
pillarbox and framing untouched

rejected_candidate.measured: after the fix and the pipeline's own solve: head spread 2.3 % on the canvas against the 2 % gate (drift 3.6 px, separation 1.77×, matte 103 %) — failed honestly, not used

zach_demo.command: ffmpeg -v error -y -ss 15 -t 60 -i zach_sain_v1.mov -vf setpts=PTS-STARTPTS -af asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset medium -threads 1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart zach_sain_v1_demo.mp4
edits: alternate real take (zach_sain_v1.mov, mint trousers, crown inside the picture)
trim 15 s → 75 s
30 fps unchanged; timestamps zeroed (setpts/asetpts) so the frame count is unambiguous — 1800 by the container, by decoding, and by the pipeline's demux
container rotation (180°) baked into the pixels by the re-encode — the picture is unchanged
video re-encoded once (x264 crf 18, 1 thread)
audio re-encoded AAC 160k (the .mov audio is not MP4-compatible as-is)

rejected_candidate.note: the same excerpt without the timestamp zeroing: the source decodes to 1800 frames but the pipeline's demux emitted 1801 (a duplicate at t=0), so the render had 1801 — caught by the live frame-count gate on AWS (FFmpeg decoder: 1801 ≠ 1800) while the local check, which counts through AVFoundation, read 1801 = 1801. Not used.
